title: Equipment Health Monitoring System
description: A web application for monitoring the health of various equipments, with real-time data visualization and alerting.

title: EduRights : Gamified Legal Awareness Platform for Children
description: This project focuses on developing an interactive web platform that spreads legal awareness among children aged 8 to 16 through gamified learning. By simplifying key child rights and legal concepts into engaging visual and game-based activities, the platform makes learning intuitive and enjoyable, helping children understand their rights and encouraging early legal awareness.
